verdict.rationale: Missive documents an official MCP server. External AI apps such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can connect to it and act on conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts with permissions the user chooses. The changelog references the MCP server directly, and pricing lists 'API & MCP access'. The separate custom-MCP client feature, where Missive's own assistant connects to other servers, is not credited here. missing for 10: detailed server setup and authentication docs in the pack (tool list, connection steps), independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: External AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now connect to Missive through the Model Context Protocol and act on your conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts, with the permissions you choose.
